connection.RnJlc2hCb29rc1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.source: A connection to the FreshBooks REST API for accounting, invoicing, and time tracking
connection.RnJlc2hCb29rc1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.message: Una connessione all'API REST di FreshBooks per la contabilità, la fatturazione e il tracciamento del tempo

connection.RnJlc2hCb29rc1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.source: The FreshBooks account ID, used for accounting API endpoints (clients, invoices, expenses, estimates, items). Find this by calling GET /auth/api/v1/users/me after authentication - it appears as 'account_id' in the business_memberships array, or in your FreshBooks URL (e.g. https://my.freshbooks.com/service/ACCOUNT_ID/...).
connection.RnJlc2hCb29rc1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.message: L'ID account di FreshBooks, utilizzato per gli endpoint API di contabilità (clienti, fatture, spese, preventivi, articoli). Trovalo chiamando GET /auth/api/v1/users/me dopo l'autenticazione - appare come 'account_id' nell'array business_memberships, oppure nella tua URL di FreshBooks (es. https://my.freshbooks.com/service/ACCOUNT_ID/...).

connection.RnJlc2hCb29rc1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.source: The FreshBooks business ID, used for time tracking API endpoints (services, time entries, projects). Find this by calling GET /auth/api/v1/users/me after authentication - it appears as 'business.id' in the business_memberships array.
connection.RnJlc2hCb29rc1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.message: L'ID azienda di FreshBooks, utilizzato per gli endpoint API di tracciamento del tempo (servizi, registrazioni orarie, progetti). Trovalo chiamando GET /auth/api/v1/users/me dopo l'autenticazione - appare come 'business.id' nell'array business_memberships.

connection.RnJlc2hCb29rc1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.source: A connection to the FreshBooks REST API
connection.RnJlc2hCb29rc1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.message: Una connessione all'API REST di FreshBooks
